title: Add Inventory
description: Tool to add or update a BaseLinker catalog (inventory). Use when you need to create a new catalog or update an existing one with the same identifier.

languages.description: An array of languages available in the inventory.

warehouses.description: An array of warehouse identifiers available in the inventory. Format: [type:bl|shop|warehouse]_[id:int]

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the getInventories method. Should be used to update an existing inventory.

price_groups.description: An array of price group identifiers available in the inventory.

default_language.description: Default inventory language. Must be included in the languages parameter.

default_warehouse.description: Identifier of the warehouse default for the inventory. The identifier must be included in the warehouses parameter.

default_price_group.description: ID of the price group default for the inventory. The identifier must be included in the price_groups parameter.

title: Add Inventory Category
description: Tool to add or update a category in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to create a new category or update an existing one. Adding a category with the same identifier again updates the previously saved category.

parent_id.description: The parent category identifier obtained previously at the output of the addCategory method. Use 0 for root-level categories.

category_id.description: The category identifier to be provided for updates. Should be left blank when creating a new category.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved by the getInventories method.

title: Add Inventory Document
description: Tool to create a new inventory document in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to create goods receipts, issues, or transfers. Documents are created as drafts and require confirmation via user action or setInventoryDocumentStatusConfirmed API method.

date_add.description: Date of document creation as Unix timestamp. If not specified, current date will be used.

date_execute.description: Date of document execution as Unix timestamp. If not specified, current date will be used.

warehouse_id.description: Source warehouse identifier where the document will be registered.

document_type.description: Document classification: 0=GR (Goods Receipt), 1=IGR (Internal Goods Receipt), 2=GI (Goods Issue), 3=IGI (Internal Goods Issue), 4=IT (Inventory Transfer), 5=OB (Opening Balance).

target_warehouse_id.description: Target warehouse identifier. Required only for transfer documents (document_type=4).

title: Add Inventory Manufacturer
description: Tool to add or update a manufacturer in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to create a new manufacturer or update an existing one. Adding a manufacturer with the same identifier again updates the previously saved manufacturer.

manufacturer_id.description: Manufacturer ID. Provide this value when updating an existing manufacturer. Leave blank when creating a new manufacturer.

title: Add Inventory Payer
description: Tool to add a new payer or update an existing one in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to create a new payer with contact details or update an existing payer's information.

payer_id.description: Payer identifier. If provided, the existing payer will be updated. If not provided, a new payer will be created.

title: Add Inventory Price Group
description: Tool to create or update a price group in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to define pricing tiers (e.g., wholesale, retail, VIP) that can be later assigned to inventory items via addInventory method.

currency.description: 3-letter currency code (ISO 4217 standard) for the price group

description.description: Price group description providing additional context about the pricing tier

price_group_id.description: Price group identifier. If provided, updates an existing price group. Omit to create a new price group.

title: Add Inventory Product
description: Add a new product to BaseLinker catalog or update an existing product. Use when creating inventory items or modifying product details like SKU, price, stock, dimensions, and text fields. Provide product_id to update existing products, omit it to create new ones.

star.description: Product star rating (0-5). 0 means no rating.

stock.description: Product stock levels by warehouse. Key is warehouse ID, value is stock quantity.

images.description: Product images (up to 16). Key is image position (0-15), value is image URL.

prices.description: Product prices by price group. Key is price group ID, value is gross price.

tax_rate.description: VAT tax rate percentage (0-100). Use -1 for tax-exempt products.

is_bundle.description: Indicates whether the product is a bundle.

parent_id.description: Product parent ID. If specified, the product becomes a variant of another product.

product_id.description: Main product identifier. Provide this only when updating an existing product. Leave blank when creating a new product.

text_fields.description: Text fields for the product (name, description, features, etc.).

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. Use getInventories method to retrieve available catalog IDs.

title: Add Inventory Purchase Order
description: Tool to create a new purchase order in BaseLinker storage. Orders are created as drafts by default. Use when you need to create a new purchase order for inventory management.

name.description: Purchase order name/title. Helps identify the order in the system.

notes.description: Additional notes or description for the purchase order.

currency.description: Order currency code (3-letter ISO code, e.g., 'EUR', 'USD', 'PLN').

payer_id.description: Payer identifier responsible for payment of this purchase order.

series_id.description: Document series identifier. Use getInventoryPurchaseOrderSeries to get available series IDs.

invoice_no.description: Related invoice number for this purchase order.

supplier_id.description: Supplier identifier from whom goods are being purchased.

date_created.description: Creation timestamp (Unix timestamp). If not provided, current time will be used.

warehouse_id.description: Warehouse identifier where the purchase order will be created.

title: Add Inventory Purchase Order Items
description: Tool to add items to an existing purchase order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to add products to a purchase order that has already been created.

items.description: List of items to add to the purchase order. Each item must include product_id, quantity, and item_cost.

order_id.description: Purchase order identifier to which items will be added.

title: Add Inventory Supplier
description: Tool to add a new supplier or update an existing one in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to manage supplier information for inventory management. If supplier_id is provided, the existing supplier will be updated; otherwise, a new supplier will be created.

supplier_id.description: Existing supplier identifier. If provided, the existing supplier will be updated.

take_product_code_from.description: Source of product code for this supplier. Available values: 'sku' (Product SKU), 'ean' (Product EAN), 'code' (Product code at the supplier), or extra field ID.

take_product_cost_from.description: Source of product cost for this supplier. Use 'cost' for product cost at the supplier, or provide a price group ID.

title: Add Inventory Warehouse
description: Tool to add a new warehouse or update an existing warehouse in BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to create new warehouse locations for inventory management or update warehouse details. Adding a warehouse with the same identifier again will update the previously saved warehouse. The method does not allow editing warehouses created automatically for external stocks.

name.description: Warehouse name. Required field with maximum length of 100 characters.

description.description: Warehouse description. Optional text field providing additional information about the warehouse.

warehouse_id.description: ID of the warehouse. Optional for creation (creates new warehouse). When provided, updates the existing warehouse with this ID. Cannot edit warehouses created automatically for external stocks (shops, wholesalers, etc.).

stock_edition.description: Whether manual editing of stocks is permitted. Set to false if you want to edit stock only through the API. Set to true to allow manual stock editing in BaseLinker interface.

title: Add Invoice
description: Tool to issue an order invoice in BaseLinker. Use when you need to generate an invoice for an existing order using a specific numbering series.

order_id.description: Order Identifier from BaseLinker order manager

vat_rate.description: VAT rate: 'DEFAULT' (uses series setting), 'ITEM' (uses item rate), 'EXPT'/'ZW' (exempt), 'NP' (annotation), 'OO' (reverse charge), or numeric 0-100. If omitted, uses series default.

series_id.description: Series numbering identifier. Use getSeries to retrieve available series IDs.

title: Add Invoice Correction
description: Tool to issue an order invoice correction. Use when correcting pricing errors, handling returns, or updating invoice data. Either original_invoice_id or return_order_id must be provided.

items.description: Array of items to correct. Required when correcting_items=1

fv_person.description: Name of the person issuing the invoice

series_id.description: Numbering series ID for the invoice correction

return_order_id.description: Return order ID - if supplied, all other fields except series_id are ignored and invoice is created using return order data

correcting_reason.description: Reason code: 1=prepayments return, 2=compulsory discounts, 3=price increase, 4=refunds, 5=goods return, 6=pricing errors, 7=address correction, 8=contract withdrawal, 9=other

original_invoice_id.description: Original invoice ID to correct. Either this or return_order_id must be provided

title: Add Order
description: Tool to add a new order to the BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to create a new order with customer details, products, and delivery information.

paid.description: Whether the order is already paid. Value 'true' automatically adds a full payment.

date_add.description: Date of order creation in unix timestamp format

products.description: Order product array. At least one product is required.

invoice_nip.description: Billing details - VAT registration number/tax number

want_invoice.description: Flag indicating whether the customer wants an invoice

extra_field_1.description: Value of 'additional field 1' - seller can store any information

extra_field_2.description: Value of 'additional field 2' - seller can store any information

invoice_address.description: Billing details - street and house number

order_status_id.description: Order status ID. Use GetOrderStatusList to retrieve available status IDs.

custom_source_id.description: Identifier of custom order source from BaseLinker panel

delivery_point_id.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point identifier

payment_method_cod.description: Flag indicating whether the payment type is COD (cash on delivery)

custom_extra_fields.description: List of custom extra fields with field_id and value pairs

delivery_point_city.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point city

delivery_point_name.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point name

invoice_country_code.description: Billing details - country code (two-letter, e.g., US, GB)

delivery_country_code.description: Delivery address - country code (two-letter, e.g., US, GB)

delivery_point_address.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point address

delivery_point_postcode.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point postcode

title: Add Order By Split
description: Tool to create a new order by splitting selected products from an existing order. Use when you need to split an order into multiple shipments or separate deliveries. The new order inherits all customer details, addresses, and settings from the original order, with only the specified products and optional delivery costs moved to it.

order_id.description: The BaseLinker order ID of the original order to split from.

items_to_split.description: Array of product items to move from the original order to the new order. Each item specifies the order_product_id and quantity to split.

delivery_cost_to_split.description: The shipping/delivery cost amount to allocate to the new order. If not specified, delivery cost remains with the original order.

title: Add Order Duplicate
description: Tool to add a new order by duplicating an existing order in BaseLinker. The new order will have the same data as the original order but with a different ID.

order_id.description: The ID of the existing order to duplicate. Must be a valid order ID in BaseLinker.

title: Add Order Return
description: Tool to add a new order return to BaseLinker. Use when creating a return for an order. Requires status_id (get from getOrderReturnStatusList), date_add (Unix timestamp), currency (3-letter code), and refunded status.

date_add.description: Date of order return creation in Unix timestamp format

order_id.description: Order ID in BaseLinker panel

refunded.description: Whether the order return is already refunded

status_id.description: Order return status ID (retrieve available statuses with getOrderReturnStatusList)

custom_source_id.description: Identifier of custom order source defined in BaseLinker panel. If not provided, default order return source is assigned.

custom_extra_fields.description: List of custom extra fields for the order return

delivery_country_code.description: Delivery address - two-letter country code (e.g., EN, US)

refund_account_number.description: Bank account number to issue a refund

title: Add Order Return Product
description: Tool to add a new product to an existing order return in BaseLinker. Use when a customer is returning items and you need to register the returned products.

ean.description: Product EAN (European Article Number) barcode number.

sku.description: Product SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) number. Unique identifier for inventory tracking.

name.description: Product name. Human-readable name of the product being returned.

weight.description: Single piece weight in kilograms. Used for shipping calculations.

storage.description: Type of product source storage. Valid values: 'db' (BaseLinker catalog), 'shop' (shop storage), 'warehouse' (warehouse).

location.description: Product location in warehouse. Physical location code or description.

quantity.description: Number of pieces being returned. Quantity must be positive.

tax_rate.description: VAT tax rate percentage (0-100). Special values: -1 (not applicable), -0.02 (reverse charge), -0.03 (margin scheme).

return_id.description: Order return identifier. The ID of the return to which the product should be added.

status_id.description: Return item status identifier. Use to set the initial status of the return item.

attributes.description: Detailed product attributes (e.g., color, size, material). Use for variant details or custom attributes.

auction_id.description: Listing ID number from marketplace (eBay/Allegro). Use for marketplace-originated products.

product_id.description: Product identifier in BaseLinker or shop storage. Use to identify the product being returned.

storage_id.description: Storage identifier. Required when storage is 'shop' or 'warehouse'.

variant_id.description: Product variant ID. Specify if the product has variants (e.g., size, color).

price_brutto.description: Single item gross price (including tax). The price per unit with VAT included.

warehouse_id.description: Product source warehouse identifier. Specify the warehouse from which the product is being returned.

order_product_id.description: ID of connected order item from BaseLinker order manager. Links this return product to an original order item.

return_reason_id.description: Return reason identifier. Specify why the product is being returned (e.g., defective, wrong item).

title: Add Shop Category
description: Tool to add a new category to BaseLinker storage (shops, warehouses, or BaseLinker inventory). Use when you need to create a new category in a connected storage's category structure. Requires a storage_id which can be obtained from GetExternalStoragesList or use 'bl_1' for BaseLinker inventory.

name.description: Category name to be added to the store.

parent_id.description: Parent category ID. Use '0' for root-level categories.

storage_id.description: Storage identifier in format '[type:bl|shop|warehouse]_[id:int]' (e.g., 'shop_2445', 'bl_1'). Use external storage ID for shop integrations or 'bl_1' for BaseLinker inventory.

title: Create Package Manual
description: Tool to register shipping details for orders when shipments are created outside BaseLinker. Use when you need to add tracking numbers and courier information for manually created shipments. Supports marking packages as return shipments.

order_id.description: Order identifier from BaseLinker order manager.

pickup_date.description: Date of dispatch in Unix timestamp format (seconds since epoch).

courier_code.description: Courier code retrieved with getCouriersList or custom courier name (e.g., 'dhl', 'ups', 'fedex').

package_number.description: Shipping/consignment tracking number assigned by the courier.

return_shipment.description: If true, marks package as a return shipment. Default: false.

title: Delete Inventory
description: Tool to delete a catalog from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to permanently remove an inventory/catalog.

inventory_id.description: Catalog identifier to delete. Obtainable via getInventories method.

title: Delete Inventory Category
description: Tool to remove categories from BaseLinker warehouse. Along with the category, the products contained therein are removed (however, this does not apply to products in subcategories). The subcategories will be changed to the highest level categories.

category_id.description: The ID of the category to remove from BaseLinker warehouse.

title: Delete Inventory Manufacturer
description: Tool to remove a manufacturer from the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to delete a manufacturer that is no longer needed or was added by mistake.

manufacturer_id.description: The ID of the manufacturer to remove from BaseLinker catalog.

title: Delete Inventory Payer
description: Tool to remove a payer from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to delete an existing payer entry by its ID.

payer_id.description: The identifier of the payer to be removed from BaseLinker storage.

title: Delete Inventory Price Group
description: Tool to remove a price group from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to delete an existing price group by its identifier.

price_group_id.description: Price group identifier to be deleted from BaseLinker storage.

title: Delete Inventory Product
description: Tool to remove a product from the BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to permanently delete an inventory product by its ID.

product_id.description: BaseLinker inventory product identifier to delete.

title: Delete Inventory Warehouse
description: Tool to remove a warehouse from BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to delete a warehouse that is no longer needed. Note: This method does not allow removal of warehouses created automatically for external stock management (shops, wholesalers, etc.).

warehouse_id.description: ID of the warehouse to remove from BaseLinker inventories.

title: Delete Order Product
description: Tool to remove a specific product from an order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to delete an order item without canceling the entire order.

order_id.description: Order ID from BaseLinker order manager.

order_product_id.description: Order item ID from BaseLinker order manager.

title: Delete Order Return Product
description: Tool to remove a specific product from an order return in BaseLinker. Use when you need to delete a product item from an existing return request.

return_id.description: The identifier for the order return from which the product will be removed.

order_return_product_id.description: The identifier of the specific product item to delete from the return.

title: Delete Orders
description: Tool to delete multiple orders from BaseLinker order manager. Use when you need to permanently remove orders from the system.

order_ids.description: Array of order IDs to delete from BaseLinker order manager. Must contain at least one order ID.

title: Get Connect Integration Contractors
description: Tool to retrieve a list of contractors connected to a selected Base Connect integration. Use when you need to discover available contractors for a specific integration before performing contractor-specific operations.

integration_id.description: The identifier of the Base Connect integration to retrieve contractors from.

title: Get Connect Integrations
description: Get Connect Integrations. Calls BaseLinker `getConnectIntegrations` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Courier Accounts
description: Tool to retrieve the list of accounts connected to a given courier. Use when you need to identify available courier accounts before performing shipping operations.

courier_code.description: Courier code to retrieve accounts for.

title: Get Courier Fields
description: Tool to retrieve the form fields required for creating shipments with a specific courier. Use when you need to discover which fields are required or optional for shipment creation.

courier_code.description: Courier code that identifies which shipping provider to query for form fields (e.g., 'dpd', 'ups', 'fedex'). Maximum 20 characters.

title: Get Courier Packages Status History
description: Tool to retrieve the history of status changes for courier packages. Use when you need to track the delivery progress of shipments through their complete status timeline. Returns chronological status updates for up to 100 packages per request.

package_ids.description: An array with a list of parcel IDs. Maximum 100 shipments at a time.

title: Get Couriers List
description: Get Couriers List. Calls BaseLinker `getCouriersList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get External Storage Products Quantity
description: Retrieve stock quantities from an external storage (shop/wholesaler) connected to BaseLinker. Use this tool to check current inventory levels for products in external integrations. Returns product IDs with their quantities, including variant-level stock if applicable.

page.description: Optional page number for pagination when dealing with large product datasets. Returns subsequent pages of results.

storage_id.description: Storage ID in format '[type:shop|warehouse]_[id:int]'. The type indicates whether it's a shop or warehouse, followed by underscore and numeric ID. Use getExternalStoragesList to discover available storage IDs.

title: Get External Storages List
description: Get External Storages List. Calls BaseLinker `getExternalStoragesList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventories
description: Get Inventories. Calls BaseLinker `getInventories` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Available Text Field Keys
description: Tool to retrieve a list of product text fields that can be overwritten for a specific integration. Use when you need to discover which text fields are available for modification within a given inventory catalog.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved by the getInventories method (inventory_id field).

title: Get Inventory Categories
description: Tool to retrieve a list of categories for a BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to fetch category hierarchies for inventory management or product organization.

inventory_id.description: Catalog identifier. Retrieve available IDs using the getInventories method's inventory_id field. Omit this parameter to access categories across all catalogs in BaseLinker.

title: Get Inventory Document Items
description: Tool to retrieve items from inventory documents in BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch product details from a specific document with support for pagination (100 items per page).

page.description: Page number for pagination (100 items per page). If not specified, returns first page.

document_id.description: Inventory document ID to retrieve items from.

title: Get Inventory Documents
description: Tool to retrieve a list of inventory documents. Use when you need to fetch inventory records with optional filters for ID, type, status, date range, warehouse, or pagination.

page.description: Page number of results (max 100 documents per page).

filter_date_to.description: Maximum creation date (Unix timestamp) to filter by.

filter_date_from.description: Minimum creation date (Unix timestamp) to filter by.

filter_document_id.description: Specific inventory document ID to filter by.

title: Get Inventory Document Series
description: Get Inventory Document Series. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryDocumentSeries` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Extra Fields
description: Get Inventory Extra Fields. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryExtraFields` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Integrations
description: Tool to retrieve a list of integrations where text values in the catalog can be overwritten. Use when you need to discover which sales channels support text customization and what languages are available for each integration.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved by the getInventories method (inventory_id field).

title: Get Inventory Manufacturers
description: Get Inventory Manufacturers. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryManufacturers` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Payers
description: Tool to retrieve a list of payers available in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to list payers, optionally filtered by ID or name.

filter_id.description: Narrows results to a specific payer identifier. When provided, only the payer with this ID will be returned.

filter_name.description: Enables filtering by payer designation using full or partial string matching (max 40 chars). Returns all payers whose names contain this string.

title: Get Inventory Price Groups
description: Get Inventory Price Groups. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryPriceGroups` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Printout Templates
description: Get Inventory Printout Templates. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryPrintoutTemplates` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Product Logs
description: Tool to retrieve a list of events related to product changes in the BaseLinker catalog. Use when tracking product modification history, auditing changes, or monitoring inventory updates.

page.description: Results page number. Returns 100 product events per page.

date_to.description: Unix timestamp. Only return logs up to this date.

log_type.description: Log type classifications for product events.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp. Only return logs from this date onwards.

product_id.description: Product identifier. For retrieving variant logs, provide the variant identifier as the product identifier.

title: Get Inventory Products Data
description: Tool to retrieve detailed data for selected products from the BaseLinker inventory. Use when you need comprehensive product information including SKU, prices, stock, dimensions, descriptions, images, variants, and bundle details.

products.description: An array of product ID numbers to download

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the method getInventories.

include_erp_units.description: Include ERP units in the response. Only available for inventories with purchase cost calculations system different than AVCO.

include_suppliers.description: Include suppliers data in the response.

include_wms_units.description: Include WMS units in the response. Only available for inventories with enabled advanced warehouse management system.

include_additional_eans.description: Include additional EANs in response. User can set additional EANs for product, to work with products cases (4-pack etc.) or different regional codes for the same product.

title: Get Inventory Products List
description: Tool to retrieve basic data of chosen products from BaseLinker catalogs. Use when you need to list products with optional filtering by ID, category, EAN, SKU, name, price range, or stock levels. Supports pagination for large catalogs (1000 products per page).

page.description: Results paging (1000 products per page for BaseLinker warehouse)

filter_id.description: Narrows results to a specific product ID

filter_ean.description: Limits results to a specific EAN code

filter_sku.description: Limiting the results to a specific SKU (stock keeping number)

filter_name.description: Filters by product name or partial name match

filter_sort.description: The value for sorting the product list. Possible values: 'id [ASC|DESC]'

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the method getInventories.

include_variants.description: Include product variants alongside main products

filter_category_id.description: Retrieves products from a particular category

title: Get Inventory Products Prices
description: Retrieve gross prices of products from BaseLinker inventories. Use when you need to get pricing information for products and their variants across different price groups. Supports pagination for large product catalogs.

page.description: Results paging (1000 products per page for BaseLinker warehouse). Start from 0 for the first page.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the method getInventories.

title: Get Inventory Products Stock
description: Tool to retrieve stock data of products from BaseLinker catalogs. Use when you need to check current inventory levels, reservations, or variant stock across warehouses. Results are paginated at 1000 products per page.

page.description: Results paging (1000 products per page for BaseLinker warehouse). Use for iterating through large inventories.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. Retrieve available catalog IDs using the getInventories method (inventory_id field).

title: Get Inventory Purchase Order Items
description: Tool to retrieve items from a specific purchase order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch product details from a purchase order with support for pagination (100 items per page).

page.description: Page number for pagination (100 items per page). If not specified, returns first page.

order_id.description: Purchase order identifier to retrieve items from.

title: Get Inventory Purchase Orders
description: Tool to retrieve a list of purchase orders from BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to fetch purchase orders with optional filters like date range, supplier or pagination.

page.description: Page number of results (100 purchase orders per page).

date_to.description: Unix timestamp up to which purchase orders should be retrieved.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp from which purchase orders should be retrieved.

series_id.description: Limit results to a specific document series ID.

supplier_id.description: Limit results to a specific supplier ID.

warehouse_id.description: Filter by warehouse identifier. Use to limit results to purchase orders for a specific warehouse.

filter_document_number.description: Filter by document number (full or partial match).

title: Get Inventory Purchase Order Series
description: Tool to retrieve a list of purchase order document series. Use when you need to select a numbering series for a new purchase order.

title: Get Inventory Suppliers
description: Tool to retrieve a list of suppliers available in BaseLinker storage. Use when you need to list suppliers, optionally filtered by ID or name.

filter_id.description: Narrows results to a specific supplier identifier. When provided, only the supplier with this ID will be returned.

filter_name.description: Enables filtering by supplier designation using full or partial string matching (max 40 chars). Returns all suppliers whose names contain this string.

title: Get Inventory Tags
description: Get Inventory Tags. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryTags` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Inventory Warehouses
description: Get Inventory Warehouses. Calls BaseLinker `getInventoryWarehouses` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Invoice File
description: Tool to retrieve an invoice file from BaseLinker in base64-encoded format. Use when you need to download an invoice document generated by BaseLinker or from an external accounting system.

get_external.description: When false (default): downloads invoice generated by BaseLinker. When true: retrieves invoice from external accounting system if available, falls back to BaseLinker format if unavailable.

title: Get Invoices
description: Download invoices from BaseLinker order manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch all invoices from a specific date onwards - Retrieve a single invoice by ID or order ID - Filter invoices by numbering series - Paginate through invoices using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 invoices per request. Use getSeries to get available series IDs for filtering.

id_from.description: Only return invoices with IDs greater than this value. Useful for pagination.

order_id.description: Retrieve the invoice associated with a specific order ID.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp. Only return invoices created on or after this date.

series_id.description: Filter invoices by numbering series ID. Use getSeries to get available series IDs.

invoice_id.description: Retrieve a specific invoice by its BaseLinker invoice ID.

get_government_data.description: If true, includes government data fields (gov_id, gov_date, gov_status) in the response. Default: false.

get_external_invoices.description: If false, excludes invoices with external files uploaded. Default: true.

title: Get Journal List
description: Tool to download order event logs from the last 3 days. Use when you need to track order activities, changes, or events. IMPORTANT: This method must be activated by BaseLinker support on your account. If not activated, it returns an empty response. Events include order creation, status changes, payments, invoices, receipts, product modifications, and package operations. Use last_log_id to paginate through results incrementally.

order_id.description: Order ID number to filter events for a specific order.

logs_types.description: Event ID list to filter by. Event types range from 1-21 (e.g., 1=order created, 3=payment received, 7=invoice issued). If not provided, all event types are returned.

last_log_id.description: Log ID number from which the logs are to be retrieved. Use to paginate through results. Must be greater than zero.

title: Get New Receipts
description: Tool to retrieve receipts waiting to be issued. Use after confirming fiscal printer availability; fetch pending receipts and mark them with setOrderReceipt.

id_from.description: Retrieve receipts with receipt_id greater than this value. Defaults to 0 if omitted.

series_id.description: Filter receipts by numbering series ID. Use separate series when multiple fiscal printers exist.

title: Get Order Extra Fields
description: Get Order Extra Fields. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderExtraFields` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Packages
description: Tool to download shipments previously created for a selected order. Use when you need to retrieve tracking numbers, courier information, and delivery status for order packages.

order_id.description: Order identifier from BaseLinker order manager.

title: Get Order Payments History
description: Tool to retrieve payment history for a selected order, including external payment identifiers from payment gateways. Use when you need to track payment events for an order. One order can have multiple payment history entries due to surcharges, order value changes, or manual payment editing.

order_id.description: Order identifier from BaseLinker order manager

show_full_history.description: Download full payment history, including order value change entries and manual order payment edits. Default: false

title: Get Order Pick Pack History
description: Tool to retrieve pick and pack history for a selected order. Use when you need to track the fulfillment timeline and events for an order (reservations, picking, packing, photography). Returns chronological list of pick/pack events with timestamps and responsible profiles.

order_id.description: Order identifier from BaseLinker order manager

action_type.description: Filter by specific event type (1-17). If omitted, returns all history entries. Common values: 1=Reservation for collecting, 2=Picking started, 5=Picking finished, 8=Packing started, 11=Packing finished

title: Get Order Printout Templates
description: Get Order Printout Templates. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderPrintoutTemplates` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Return Extra Fields
description: Get Order Return Extra Fields. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderReturnExtraFields` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Return Journal List
description: Tool to download return event logs from the last 3 days in BaseLinker. Use when tracking return order history, monitoring return status changes, or auditing return-related activities. Returns events like return creation, status changes, product modifications, and refund creation.

return_id.description: Return ID number to filter events for a specific return order.

logs_types.description: List of event type IDs to filter by. Valid types: 1 (Return creation), 2 (Accepted by customer), 3 (Completed), 4 (Cancelled), 5 (Status change), 6 (Products change), 7 (Data change), 8 (New product), 9 (Product removal), 10 (Invoice created), 11 (Parcel created), 12 (Refund created).

last_log_id.description: Log ID number from which the logs are to be retrieved. Use this to paginate through results.

title: Get Order Return Payments History
description: Tool to retrieve payment history for a selected order return, including external payment identifiers from the payment gateway. Use when you need to track payment events, surcharges, order value changes, or manual payment edits for a return.

show_full_history.description: Download full payment history including order value changes and manual edits. Default: false.

title: Get Order Return Product Statuses
description: Get Order Return Product Statuses. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderReturnProductStatuses` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Return Reasons List
description: Get Order Return Reasons List. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderReturnReasonsList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Returns
description: Download order returns from BaseLinker return manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch returns from a specific date onwards using date_from parameter - Retrieve a single return by return_id - Filter returns by source order, status, or marketplace source - Paginate through returns using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 order returns per request. For complete return data including custom fields, set include_custom_extra_fields=true. Use include_connect_data=true for Base Connect integration info.

id_from.description: Return ID threshold. Only returns with return_id greater than this value will be included. Useful for pagination.

order_id.description: Identifier of the order the return was created from. Filter returns by source order.

date_from.description: Return creation date (Unix timestamp). Only returns created on or after this date will be included.

return_id.description: Order return identifier. Use to download only one specific return.

status_id.description: Status identifier filter. Leave blank to download returns from all statuses.

include_connect_data.description: If true, include Base Connect integration and contractor data. Default: false.

include_custom_extra_fields.description: If true, download values of custom additional fields. Default: false.

filter_order_return_source_id.description: Filter by order return source identifier. Requires filter_order_return_source to be set.

title: Get Order Return Status List
description: Get Order Return Status List. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderReturnStatusList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Orders
description: Download orders from BaseLinker order manager with optional filtering. Use this tool to: - Fetch all orders from a specific date onwards - Retrieve a single order by ID - Filter orders by status, email, or marketplace source - Paginate through orders using id_from parameter Returns up to 100 orders per request. For confirmed orders only, omit get_unconfirmed_orders. Tip: Use getOrderStatusList to get status IDs for filtering.

id_from.description: Only return orders with IDs greater than or equal to this value. Useful for pagination.

order_id.description: Retrieve a single specific order by its BaseLinker order ID.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp. Only return orders created on or after this date.

status_id.description: Filter orders by status ID. Use getOrderStatusList to get available status IDs.

filter_email.description: Filter orders by customer email address (exact match).

date_confirmed_from.description: Unix timestamp. Only return orders confirmed on or after this date.

filter_shop_order_id.description: Filter by shop-specific order ID (the ID from the external marketplace/shop).

include_connect_data.description: If true, include Base Connect integration and contractor data. Default: false.

filter_order_source_id.description: Filter orders by source account ID. Requires filter_order_source to be set.

get_unconfirmed_orders.description: If true, include unconfirmed orders (e.g., orders where customer hasn't completed delivery form). Default: false.

include_commission_data.description: If true, include marketplace commission data for each product. Default: false.

include_custom_extra_fields.description: If true, include custom extra field values in the response. Default: false.

title: Get Orders by Phone
description: Search for orders associated with a specific phone number in BaseLinker. Use when identifying callers in phone recognition systems or finding order history by phone. Returns basic order information including status, recipient names, and timestamps.

phone.description: Phone number to search for in orders. The phone number can include country code prefix (e.g., +48123456789). Returns all orders associated with this phone number. Maximum length is 50 characters.

title: Get Order Sources
description: Get Order Sources. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderSources` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Status List
description: Get Order Status List. Calls BaseLinker `getOrderStatusList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Order Transaction Data
description: Tool to retrieve transaction details for a selected order. Use when you need marketplace transaction IDs, fulfillment data, or detailed tax breakdowns for an order.

order_id.description: Order identifier from BaseLinker order manager

include_amazon_data.description: Include legacy Amazon fulfillment data for backward compatibility. Default: true

include_complex_taxes.description: Include detailed tax breakdown with order_lines structure in order_items. Default: false

title: Get Package Details
description: Tool to get detailed information about a package. If the package contains multiple subpackages, information about all of them is included in the response. Use when you need comprehensive package dimensions, weight, COD, insurance, and shipping cost details.

package_id.description: The unique identifier of the package for which you want to retrieve details.

title: Get PickPack Carts
description: Get PickPack Carts. Calls BaseLinker `getPickPackCarts` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Protocol
description: Tool to download a parcel protocol for selected shipments. Use when you need to retrieve shipping protocol documents (PDF or HTML) for packages sent via a courier. The protocol is available only if supported by the chosen courier.

account_id.description: Courier API account identifier. Retrieve account IDs using getCourierAccounts for the specified courier.

package_ids.description: Array of shipment identifiers. Either package_ids or package_numbers must be provided, not both.

courier_code.description: Courier code for which to retrieve the protocol. Use codes from getCouriersList.

package_numbers.description: Array of shipment consignment numbers. Either package_ids or package_numbers must be provided, not both.

title: Get Receipts
description: Tool to retrieve issued receipts from BaseLinker. Use when you need to fetch historical receipt data. Max 100 receipts returned per request.

date_to.description: Sets the end date for receipt collection in Unix timestamp format.

id_from.description: Specifies the receipt ID from which subsequent receipts will be retrieved (inclusive).

date_from.description: Sets the start date for receipt collection in Unix timestamp format.

series_id.description: Enables filtering results by receipt numbering series identifier.

title: Get Request Parcel Pickup Fields
description: Tool to retrieve additional fields for a parcel pickup request from a specific courier. Use when preparing to request a parcel pickup and need to know which additional information the courier requires (e.g., pickup time, contact details, special instructions).

title: Get Series
description: Get Series. Calls BaseLinker `getSeries` via POST /connector.php.

title: Get Storages List
description: Get Storages List. Calls BaseLinker `getStoragesList` via POST /connector.php.

title: Run Order Macro Trigger
description: Tool to run personal trigger for orders automatic actions. Use when you need to execute a specific automation trigger on an order.

order_id.description: The ID of the order to run the trigger on

trigger_id.description: The ID of the personal trigger to execute

title: Run Product Macro Trigger
description: Tool to execute a personal trigger for products automatic actions. Use when you need to manually run a custom event trigger for a specific product in BaseLinker inventory.

product_id.description: Product identifier from BaseLinker product manager.

trigger_id.description: Identifier of personal trigger from products automatic actions.

title: Run Request Parcel Pickup
description: Tool to request a parcel pickup for previously created shipments. Use when you need to schedule a courier pickup for packages that have been created. The method sends a pickup request to the courier API if the courier supports it. Use getRequestParcelPickupFields first to check if the courier requires additional fields.

fields.description: Optional array of additional fields required by the courier (e.g., pickup date, contact person). Use getRequestParcelPickupFields to determine required fields for the courier.

account_id.description: The courier account identifier. Must be a positive integer.

package_numbers.description: Array of package tracking numbers to request pickup for. Must contain at least one package number.

title: Set Inventory Purchase Order Status
description: Tool to change the status of a purchase order in BaseLinker inventory. Use when you need to update a purchase order's status (e.g., mark as sent, received, completed, or canceled).

order_id.description: Purchase order identifier to update.

completed_items.description: List of items with their completion quantities. Each item includes item_id and completed_quantity.

title: Set Order Fields
description: Tool to edit selected fields of a specific order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update order details such as address data, notes, payment method, delivery information, or invoice details. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields can be omitted.

order_id.description: Order identifier from the BaseLinker order manager

user_login.description: Buyer's account name (Allegro or eBay user login)

invoice_nip.description: Billing details - VAT registration number/tax number

want_invoice.description: Flag indicating whether the customer wants an invoice

extra_field_1.description: Value of 'additional field 1' - seller can store any information

extra_field_2.description: Value of 'additional field 2' - seller can store any information

invoice_address.description: Billing details - street and house number

delivery_fullname.description: Delivery address - recipient name and surname

delivery_point_id.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point identifier

payment_method_cod.description: Flag indicating whether the payment type is COD (cash on delivery)

custom_extra_fields.description: List of custom extra fields with field_id and value pairs

delivery_point_city.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point city

delivery_point_name.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point name

invoice_country_code.description: Billing details - country code (two-letter, e.g., US, GB)

delivery_country_code.description: Delivery address - country code (two-letter, e.g., US, GB)

delivery_point_address.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point address

delivery_point_postcode.description: Pick-up point delivery - pick-up point postcode

title: Set Order Payment
description: Tool to add a payment to an order in BaseLinker. Use when recording a payment for an order. The payment amount replaces (not adds to) the current payment value; if it matches the order total, the order is marked as paid.

order_id.description: Order ID number

payment_done.description: The amount of the payment. The value changes the current payment in the order (not added to the previous value). If the amount matches the order value, the order will be marked as paid.

external_payment_id.description: External payment identifier from payment gateway

title: Set Order Product Fields
description: Tool to edit data of selected items in a specific BaseLinker order. Use when you need to update product fields like prices, quantities, SKU, or other item details. Only provide the fields you want to edit; other fields can be omitted.

order_id.description: Order identifier from the BaseLinker order manager

tax_rate.description: VAT tax rate e.g. '23', (value from range 0-100)

attributes.description: The detailed product attributes, e.g. 'Colour: blue'

auction_id.description: Listing ID number (if the order comes from ebay/allegro)

product_id.description: Product identifier in BaseLinker or shop storage

warehouse_id.description: Product source warehouse identifier. Only applies to products

order_product_id.description: Order item ID from BaseLinker order manager

title: Set Order Receipt
description: Tool to mark orders with a receipt already issued. Use after printing receipts retrieved from getNewReceipts to confirm receipt issuance.

date.description: Receipt printing date in Unix timestamp format.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID number received from the getNewReceipts method.

receipt_nr.description: The number of the issued receipt. May be blank if the printer does not return a number.

printer_name.description: Name identifying the printer device used for printing.

printer_error.description: Flag indicating receipt printing errors. Defaults to false if not specified.

title: Set Order Return Fields
description: Tool to edit selected fields of a specific order return. Use when updating return information such as buyer contact details, delivery address, or custom fields. Only the fields that need to be changed should be provided; other fields can be omitted.

custom_extra_fields.description: Custom extra fields with ID as key. Supports file uploads (2MB limit) in format {'title': 'filename.pdf', 'file': 'data:base64_content'} or empty strings for removal

title: Set Order Return Product Fields
description: Tool to edit data of selected items (e.g., prices, quantities, attributes) of a specific order return product. Use when you need to update fields of a returned product in an order return.

storage.description: Product source type: 'db' (internal inventory), 'shop' (online shop), or 'warehouse' (wholesaler)

tax_rate.description: VAT rate (0-100, or special values: -1 for exempt, -0.02 for NP, -0.03 for reverse charge)

return_id.description: Order return identifier from the BaseLinker order manager

auction_id.description: Listing ID (for eBay/Allegro orders). Use for marketplace-originated products.

product_id.description: Product identifier in BaseLinker or shop storage

storage_id.description: Identifier of the storage source. Required when storage is 'shop' or 'warehouse'.

variant_id.description: Product variant ID. Specify if the product has variants (e.g., size, color).

order_return_product_id.description: Order return item ID from BaseLinker order manager. The specific product within the return to edit.

title: Set Order Return Refund
description: Tool to mark an order return as refunded in BaseLinker. Use when recording that a refund has been issued for a return. Note: This method doesn't issue an actual money refund - it only updates the refund status in BaseLinker.

return_id.description: Order return identifier. The ID of the return to mark as refunded.

refund_date.description: Refund date in Unix timestamp format. The date when the refund was issued.

refund_comment.description: Refund commentary. A note describing the refund details or reason.

order_refund_done.description: The amount of the refund. The value changes the current refund in the order return (not added to the previous value).

external_refund_id.description: External refund identifier. Optional reference ID from external payment system or refund processor.

title: Set Order Return Status
description: Tool to change order return status in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update the status of a single order return.

status_id.description: Status ID number. The status list can be retrieved using getOrderReturnStatusList

title: Set Order Return Statuses
description: Tool to batch set order return statuses in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update the status of multiple order returns at once.

status_id.description: Order return status ID number. The status list can be retrieved using getOrderReturnStatusList

return_ids.description: Array of order return ID numbers to update

title: Set Orders Merge
description: Tool to merge multiple orders into one, based on the selected merge mode. Use when you need to combine orders together with either technical merge or into main order mode.

merge_mode.description: Selection between 'technical_merge' (creates new technical order) or 'into_main_order' (moves items, deletes others)

main_order_id.description: ID of the primary order whose shipping and invoice data will be retained

order_ids_to_merge.description: List of additional order IDs to merge; cannot include main_order_id

sum_delivery_costs.description: true = sum all shipping costs; false = keep main order's shipping cost only

title: Set Order Status
description: Tool to change the status of an existing order in BaseLinker. Use when you need to update an order's status to a different value.

order_id.description: Order ID number to update the status for.

status_id.description: Status ID number to set for the order. The status list can be retrieved using GetOrderStatusList.

title: Set Order Statuses
description: Tool to batch update order statuses in BaseLinker. Use when you need to set the same status for multiple orders at once.

order_ids.description: Collection of order ID numbers to update. At least one order ID is required.

status_id.description: Status ID number to set for all specified orders. Use GetOrderStatusList to retrieve available status IDs.

title: Update Inventory Products Stock
description: Tool to update stocks of products and their variants in BaseLinker catalog. Use when you need to modify inventory levels for products across warehouses. Maximum 1000 products per request.

products.description: An object where each key is a product ID and the value contains warehouse stock mappings. For variants, use the variant ID as the product ID. Within each product, warehouse IDs serve as keys with stock quantities as values. Warehouse identifiers follow the format [type:bl|shop|warehouse]_[id:int] (e.g., bl_123). Maximum 1000 products at a time.

inventory_id.description: Catalog ID. The list of identifiers can be retrieved using the method getInventories.
